name: Turtle shell
look: Black tortoise shell barrier from cultivation fantasy. A dome of dark jade-green hexagonal shell plates with glowing seams covers the character like a tortoise shell.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the shell dome alone, every hexagonal plate in place, no glow

parts.name: PLATE
parts.text: one hexagonal shell plate alone, its glowing seam round it

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: jade chips, a crack line, dust

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the seams, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the plates slam down from above one after another and lock into the dome with a puff of dust
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the shell holds, a dim green light running along the seams between the plates; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes the right side; the struck plate cracks, dust and stone chips burst out to the right

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the plates crack and crumble into falling stones and dust
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
